mobbin:f6612862-77f9-4b6c-9ed5-4416ad9e8.summary: From In-store home, user starts Scan&Go, scans into a running tally, reviews My Items, is sent to physical checkout with a pending QR, and finishes on a dated receipt.
steal: During the session, a live dollar total and N Items tally, Scan an item as the main action, and keypad or manual barcode fallback beside dismiss (screens 3–4).
After a scan, My Items offers Continue to Payment, Scan next item, or Use my lists, so you can keep scanning or finalize (screen 5).
An information strip forces Pay at Scan&Go Checkout; Payment Pending shows a kiosk QR plus I've scanned my code (screens 7–8).
Closure is a receipt with itemized list, store, POS, and transaction ids, plus a timestamp as the audit trail after auto checkout (screen 9).
avoid: Retail payment and rewards steps (Adding Rewards, Visa checkout). Essentials needs session or room assignment, not purchase.
mobbin:f6612862-77f9-4b6c-9ed5-4416ad9e8.fit: Inventory: strong automated check-out analog for barcode check-out of kits or consumables: scan loop, running count, optional list attach, then physical confirm via QR and a durable usage receipt.
